Asset Management Advisors Has Cut Stake in Int’l Business Machines (IBM) as Valuation Declined; Bbr Partners Holding in Albemarle (ALB) Has Trimmed as Stock Price Declined
May 23, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Asset Management Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Int’l Business Machines (IBM) by 12.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Asset Management Advisors Llc sold 7,393 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.39% with the market. The institutional investor held 51,737 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.94M, down from 59,130 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Asset Management Advisors Llc who had been investing in Int’l Business Machines for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $133.19B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.27% or $0.4 during the last trading session, reaching $145.09. About 2.28 million shares traded. International Business Machines Corporation (NYSE:IBM) has declined 12.58% downtrending. It has underperformed by 24.13% the S&P500.
Bbr Partners Llc decreased its stake in Albemarle Corp (ALB) by 40.37% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bbr Partners Llc sold 6,587 shares as the company’s stock declined 27.74% with the market. The hedge fund held 9,731 shares of the major chemicals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.24 million, down from 16,318 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bbr Partners Llc who had been investing in Albemarle Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $11.34 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.66% or $1.73 during the last trading session, reaching $102.34. About 1.03 million shares traded. Albemarle Corporation (NYSE:ALB) has declined 10.68% downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.23% the S&P500.
Analysts await Albemarle Corporation (NYSE:ALB) to report earnings on August, 6. They expect $1.22 earnings per share, up 7.96% or $0.09 from last year’s $1.13 per share. ALB’s profit will be $135.13 million for 20.97 P/E if the $1.22 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.30 actual earnings per share reported by Albemarle Corporation for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -6.15% negative EPS growth.
